vexa.purpose: SSOT architecture model: module/service/contract inventory AND the runtime data plane (carriers, ownership, flows, egress boundary). gate:dataflow enforces model<->disk completeness, single-writer + render-only ownership, and a reality diff against code; gate:calm validates it against the FINOS meeting-intelligence pattern.
vexa.principle: P23 — one writer per data carrier; readers never re-derive a producer's data; the model covers every module/service/contract (no drift).
